name: Sitcom: Character Headshot
description: Image preset for a character headshot in the Sitcom look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a headshot. Lead with the character's defining facial features, hair, and expression from the entity, then apply the style. Keep the background plain.
context_prompt: head-and-shoulders portrait of the character, face fills the frame, eyes sharp, neutral background that does not compete, multi-camera sitcom still, bright even studio lighting, three-wall standing set dressed with lived-in detail, medium shot at eye level, high-key lighting with soft shadows, warm saturated colour, everything in focus
negative_prompt: dark moody lighting, cinematic shallow focus, horror, gritty grain, text, watermark
